text: All German residents need health insurance, even when unemployed. This guide explains how health insurance works when you have no income. Losing your job in Germany

title: With public health insurance

title: With private health insurance
text: Yourprivate health insurancebecomes more expensive, because you employer stops paying half of it. The coverage stays the same. If you getunemployment benefitsYou must switch topublic health insurance, then you get insured for free.2TheAgentur für Arbeitpays it.3In some cases, you can keep your private health insurance.4If you are over 55 years old, you must usually keep your private health insurance.5 If you don’t get unemployment benefitsYou keep your private health insurance.1TheAgentur für Arbeitpays €210per month.7Your employer does not pay half of it. For example, if your private health insurance costs €500per month, your employer paid €250, and you paid €250. If you lose your job, you pay €500alone without help. Who gets unemployment benefits
When you start a new job, you must switch to public health insurance. If you make more than €77,400per year, you can choose private health insurance instead. Health insurance for employees
